values.value: You managed budgets, processed payroll, handled HR functions, and kept administrative operations running accurately under auditable conditions. You worked with government financial systems, understood reporting requirements, and made sure records were complete and correct. You know how to manage money carefully, support an organization through its administrative backbone, and operate within strict compliance requirements.
